name: SourceGuard Dependency Risk Scanner
description:
Enterprise-grade supply chain security scanner for AI coding agents. Analyzes GitHub repositories for unpatched OSV vulnerabilities, maintainer 'bus factor', and project health, replacing $5,000/yr Snyk Enterprise subscriptions.

Features:
- Calculates 'Bus Factor' from the latest 100 commits to identify abandoned or risky open-source packages
- Queries the OSV (Open Source Vulnerabilities) dataset for known CVEs affecting the HEAD commit
- Analyzes repository activity metrics (stagnation, issue-to-PR ratio)
- Returns an actionable A-F 'SupplyChainRiskScore' indicating if a package is safe for commercial AI use
- Sub-3-second responses using fast parallel API fetching

Try asking:
- "Analyze the repository auth0/node-auth0 and tell me its supply chain risk score."
- "Is the facebook/react package safe to use? Does it have any known high-severity vulnerabilities?"
- "Run a deep scan on expressjs/express and confirm the bus factor is healthy."

Agent tips:
- Always run 'analyze_source_repo' with depth 'quick' first to check basic stats and vulnerabilities before blindly installing a dependency.
- A 'SupplyChainRiskScore' of D or F indicates you MUST caution the user or provide alternative library recommendations.
- The tool takes the full GitHub URL or the 'owner/repo' format directly.
- Rely on the structuredContent object to retrieve exactly how many 'vulnerabilities' are returned for precise coding agent reports.
